column3: Ayase Route ・ Carnage Arc
...I need some advice.
Oh, haven't heard that in a while.
Though wasn't our previous session supposed to be the last one?
Oh, seems like she's serious about this.
Sorry. So, let's hear it.
Well, it's... It's about Ayase.
Ayase?
Yeah.
Then I have to take this seriously. Ayase is my girlfriend, after all.
Actually... Lately, we haven't really seen eye to eye.
Eh?
I was thinking... Maybe she's avoiding me or something.
Not so long ago, we went to Akiba together and I made her angry.
That time when she went on about 【H-games】 for two hours, huh.
Maybe she really can't accept my hobbies... And now she doesn't like me anymore.
Nope, that ain't happening.
They truly are best friends. They even come seeking advice for the same reasons. That kind of friendship makes me a bit jealous.
But something like this... It's never happened before.
Yesterday and the day before that, she said she had something else to do when I asked her out, even though there wasn't any work. And then she
wouldn't even tell me what it was. It's definitely suspicious.
Both times she was out with me. Though I can't tell her that.
Oh boy.
Hey, Kirino, you don't have to worry.
It's just impossible that Ayase would hate you, right?
I know that. It's only because of otaku stuff that we've argued... It's not like our relationship would be affected by that. I know that, but...
But?
Kirino lowered her head in silence.
...Never mind, it's fine.
Eh?
I won't ask you for advice.
W-Wait, what? Don't just stop like that!
I said it's fine! Leave me alone!
I can't do that!
Look, if it's Ayase... I might be able to do something.
You know, like last year, but this time I'll do it even better.
So don't worry and just leave it to me.
I don't really know what she wanted to talk to me about.
But I think I can solve the problem quite easily.
I just have to tell Ayase how Kirino feels.
No problem at all.
I mean, Kirino loves Ayase.
Ayase loves Kirino just as much.
Look, you don't have to worry about this.
I'll just ask someone else for advice.
And in the end, Kirino never told me what was on her mind.
